instruction: `ds/tree.py::height` reports a single-node tree as height 0 and a balanced two-level tree as height 1. Leaves are treated as zero-height, so every non-empty tree comes out one level too short. The empty tree is unaffected.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/ds/tree.py b/ds/tree.py
--- a/ds/tree.py
+++ b/ds/tree.py
@@ -18,6 +18,4 @@
     """
     if node is None:
         return 0
-    if node.left is None and node.right is None:
-        return 0
     return 1 + max(height(node.left), height(node.right))
